title: Customs Enforcement - Uganda Revenue Authority
text:
# Customs Enforcement
Here, we are dedicated to providing you with valuable information and resources related to the enforcement of customs laws and regulations in the country. Our aim is to assist you in understanding the vital role of customs enforcement in safeguarding national security, protecting the economy, and promoting fair trade practises. With a comprehensive range of articles, guides, and updates, we strive to keep you well-informed about the latest enforcement measures, procedures, and initiatives undertaken by the Uganda Revenue Authority (URA). Whether you are a customs officer, a trade professional, or simply interested in learning more about customs enforcement in Uganda, we invite you to explore our website and discover insights that will help you stay compliant, combat smuggling and illegal trade, and contribute to the overall integrity of our customs system. Together, let us foster a strong and secure trade environment in Uganda.
Customs and enforcement play a critical role in each country’s compliance and enforcement chain. The customs mandate is multi-faceted and includes; revenue collection to finance the government’s recurrent and development expenditures, as well as protection of society from undesirable and harmful products and advice on trade policy matters.
